rounds.diagnosis: Two faults. Re-pick the stage point to teapot.spout_tip so the standoff puts the spout over the mug opening. Rewrite the stage so the path admits the orientation sweep from upright to the poured tilt (only the subgoal should require the fully tilted spout-down orientation) while keeping the spout centered above mug.opening_center throughout.
